description: This file provides utility functions for handling input/output operations, such as retrieving data directories and writing text files atomically within a project. It includes a method for resolving the project base directory based on the current file's location, and functions for getting the data directory path and securely writing text to files.

methods.name: Path _base_dir()
methods.description: Resolves and returns the base directory of the project by navigating two levels up from the current file's location.

methods.name: Path get_data_dir()
methods.description: Determines the path to the data directory, either from the DATA_DIR environment variable or defaulting to a 'data' subdirectory within the project base directory.

methods.name: None safe_write_text(path: Path, text: str)
methods.description: Atomically writes text content to a specified file, creating necessary parent directories and ensuring data is flushed to disk.
